Marketing round.about: Daily: measure downloads, answer comments on our posts, and move the marketing on by marketing/PLAYBOOK.md

steps.say: Marketing round. Read marketing/PLAYBOOK.md first and follow every rule in it. 1) Write today's download count into marketing/LOG.md. 2) Open every post in marketing/LOG.md from the last 30 days (except Hacker News, which is the human's) and answer new comments since {since} by the playbook; anything you may not answer becomes a quest blocked on the human. 3) If fewer than two public actions are logged for today and no open quest covers the next row of marketing/CHANNELS.md, add one quest for it with horadric quest add and the playbook line in its notes. 4) Commit marketing/ and push as the playbook's GitHub section says. Then stop.
